notes: Version 36.2 is a small update for people using 365 PC Manager outside the UK. Our phone, visits, support plans and remote help are for customers in the UK, so on a PC abroad the app no longer offers them anywhere - including in its health report - and its safety advice works wherever you are. The Unlock everything window now links its licence and 30-day refund. In the UK everything works just as before. Signed by 365 Techies Ltd.
